products.title: iTarang Home Inverter 900VA
products.subtitle: 900VA Pure Sine Wave Home Inverter with 150Ah Lithium Battery
products.description: 900VA pure sine wave home inverter with a 150Ah lithium battery. Runs 4 fans, 6 LED lights and a television for up to 4 hours on full load. Includes a 3-year warranty on the inverter and battery. Designed for Indian voltage conditions with wide-input protection.

additional_info.title: Key Specifications
additional_info.description:
VA Rating: 900 VA

Battery Capacity: 150 Ah

Backup: Up to 4 hours

Battery Type: Lithium

Wave Type: Pure sine wave

Warranty: 3 years
